observationsNotFindings: The v1 defect is worth naming precisely because it is a class the register makes easy. This family's registerRow is the gate DR-G14, and DR-G14's own row token is OPEN, but the adjacent row DR-119 is SATISFIED under D-056 Class B. v1 carried DR-119's token in the file08StatusToken field, which would have made a leftover-join on an OPEN gate look as though it sat on a satisfied row. The repair does not merely swap the string - it adds registerRowNote explaining which token belongs where and moves the DR-119 standing onto OBL-DR119-SATISFIED-NOT-REOPENED, so the true standing is preserved rather than deleted.

Measurement is genuinely untouched. All six obligations are object-identical to v1 and the thirteen changed leaves are identity, the token, the two new explanatory fields, the finding record, the added predecessor pin and its recordedInputs entries, and the remeasurement clause. A reader can rely on the v1 measurement without re-deriving it, which is what a wording-repair successor should offer.

The predecessor role uses the non-self-referential formulation - 'Not this artifact's version number' - that the sdk family adopted after the same class of stale-self-reference defect. Seeing it appear independently here suggests the pattern is propagating as a convention rather than as a one-off repair, which is the right outcome.

OBL-G14-FX-AUTHORING remains the single open obligation and its three classes are inherited rather than authored, so the remaining work is fixture bytes for a corpus that is already fully named. That is a narrower remainder than most rows in this sweep carry, though execution still rides G14 qualification and the DR-118 language-quality leftovers stay where they are.
